lcc_original: 飛鳥各從其類，牲畜各從其類，地上一切爬行動物、各從其類，每樣兩個：都要來找你保全性命。
notes: UNV 昆蟲<WAH04480><WAH03605><WH07431> is split across LCC structure: 一切<WAH03605> receives כֹּל since LCC renders it explicitly as a separate word, while 爬行動物<WAH04480><WH07431> carries the remaining prefix + head-noun tags.

UNV 要到<WH0935><WTH8799>你那裡<WAH0413> mapped to LCC 來<WH0935><WTH8799>找你<WAH0413>; 找 has no independent SN and functions as a directional complement to 來; WAH0413 (אֶל) attaches to 找你 as the closest equivalent of 'to you'.
LCC 都 is a cohesive/universal particle with no direct Hebrew counterpart and is left unannotated.
LCC 性命 vs UNV 生命 are near-synonyms; both map cleanly to <WH02421><WTH8687> (חיה, Hiphil infinitive).
